method: Built-in image generation; model version cannot be selected by this tool
prompts:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Create a BRAND NEW easy-to-understand Korean explanatory diagram, image 1 of a coordinated pair. The previous diagrams were unreadably dense. Audience: Korean undergraduate preparing a smart-farm data contest. Make this an excellent presentation slide: LARGE crisp Korean typography, short phrases, generous whitespace, clear thick arrows, restrained flat illustrations of greenhouse, data sheets, prediction chart, calculator. Light ivory background, deep forest-green headings, soft green first lane and warm orange second lane. Flat editorial design, no photorealism, no dense technical flowchart, no decorative tiny print. Wide 3:2 landscape, high resolution. All text must be accurate Korean and legible, no invented scores or monetary values.

TITLE exact: "스마트팜 도입 판단, 이렇게 합니다"
SUBTITLE exact: "중요한 데이터와 판단 과정만 한눈에"

Two clearly separate HORIZONTAL lanes. Each lane has three large stages. NO arrow between the two lanes.

TOP LANE heading: "1  출하량·매출 예측"
Small prominent status chip: "코드 준비 완료 · 실제 자료 검증은 안심구역에서"

Top left stage label: "농정원 미개방 데이터"
Inside two illustrated data sheets, exact short text:
"시설 데이터"
"작물·지역·온실·면적·재배기간"
"경영조사"
"출하량(kg)·총수입(원)"
Below these sheets, show the key connection as an easy rule:
"같은 시설 + 조사일이 포함된 재배기간"
Then a rightward arrow to middle stage.

Top middle stage label: "내 재배 계획 7개"
Clearly list these exact seven inputs, numbered or with small icons, no omitted item:
"작물" / "지역" / "단동·연동" / "온실 규모" / "면적" / "시작 연도" / "시작 월"
Below, compact model chip:
"중앙값 · CatBoost · XGBoost 비교"
"LimiX는 별도 비교"
Then a rightward arrow to final stage.

Top right stage label: "예측 목표"
Two large outcome labels with simple icons:
"출하량 kg"
"매출 원"
Include "같은 시설은 학습·검증에서 분리"
Include "매출 ≠ 순이익"

BOTTOM LANE heading: "2  비용 대비 경제성 비교"
Status chip: "계산기 구현 완료"
Bottom left stage:
"농촌진흥청 소득자료"
"수량·농가수취가격·비용"
"2020–2024 · 266행"
Arrow to middle stage:
"내 면적 + 설치 견적"
"수량·가격·비용 변동 가정"
Arrow to right stage:
"소득 · 현금흐름"
"투자 회수기간 · NPV"

BOTTOM EXPLANATION STRIP, readable with three concise statements and simple symbols:
"미개방 자료는 합성 40시설·80작기로 실행 확인"
"재배 후 환경·생육 값은 도입 전 입력에서 제외"
"두 경로는 현재 별도 계산 · 수익 보장 아님"

Constraints: Preserve all stated meaningful content. Do not add English column names or datatype jargon. Do not imply actual private records were obtained or their predictive accuracy validated. Do not imply the top lane feeds its outputs into the bottom economic calculator. No fake percentage accuracy, no invented app screenshots. Labels may wrap naturally, never break Korean words awkwardly. The short texts above are the entire image copy; avoid extra paragraphs. Emphasize understanding at first glance.

Use case: infographic-diagram.
Create a BRAND NEW Korean explanatory infographic, image 2 of the smart-farm pair. LARGE legible Korean typography, excellent whitespace and visual hierarchy. Broad 3:2 landscape canvas at high resolution. Coordinated cream-white background, forest green text, soft green and muted orange accents. Flat friendly greenhouse, crop crate, calendar, spreadsheet and weather illustrations. This must feel like a clear presentation infographic, never a screenshot of a software flowchart. No thin crisscross arrows or tiny footnotes.

TITLE exact: "어떤 데이터를 실제로 썼나요?"
SUBTITLE: "데이터별 역할과 검증 상태를 나눠 봅니다"

Main composition: FOUR spacious illustrated cards arranged in a 2 by 2 grid. Each contains a source label, simple record-to-training count arrow, the result being predicted, and one key limitation. Make the training sample counts especially prominent.

CARD 1:
"스마트팜코리아 · 딸기"
"출하 400행 → 77작기·61시설"
"예측: 재배기간 동안 기록된 출하량(kg)"
"API로 면적·시설정보 연결"
"생육·환경 관측값은 예측 입력에서 제외"

CARD 2:
"스마트팜코리아 · 5품목"
"1,474행 → 192작기·146시설"
"딸기·오이·토마토·방울토마토·파프리카"
"예측: 기록된 매출(원)"
"면적 단위가 달라 면적 입력 제외"

CARD 3:
"농촌진흥청 ADP"
"재배 237행 → 170작기·127그룹"
"예측: 정식 후 첫 출하 기록까지 일수"
"실제 첫 수확일과는 다름"
"수량 단위 미확정 → 생산량 예측 보류"

CARD 4:
"농촌진흥청 소득자료"
"2020–2024 · 266행"
"수량·가격·비용을 면적에 맞춰 계산"
"용도: 소득·현금흐름·투자 회수기간 비교"
"설치비와 수량·가격 변화는 사용자 가정"

Under the four cards, one readable common modeling band:
"농가 자료 모델 비교: 중앙값 · CatBoost · XGBoost · LimiX-2 400M"
"같은 시설·농가는 학습과 검증에 겹치지 않음 · 그룹별 5분할"

Under that, a slim but readable three-column reference data band. This is supporting information, not extra prediction outputs.
Column 1:
"가격 참고 · KAMIS"
"월별 814건 / kg 기준 574건"
"도매가격 ≠ 농가수취가격"
Column 2:
"기후·설치비 참고"
"기후평년 2,628행 · 온실 계획단가 2건"
"기후는 현재 모델 입력에 미사용"
Column 3:
"API 생산·비용"
"생산 2,823행 · 비용 99행"
"함께 있는 작기 2개 · 기간 확인 전 순이익 학습 보류"

BOTTOM STATUS exact, high contrast and readable:
"공개·회원자료 실험 완료 / 대회 미개방 자료의 실제 검증은 별도"
Small definition still readable: "작기 = 한 번 재배하는 기간 · 매출은 순이익이 아닙니다"

Constraints: Keep all the explicit counts and labels correct. Never confuse source rows with independent farms. No invented numerical predictions, accuracy percentages or causal smartfarm gains. No diagram arrow from the crop-cycle predictions into the RDA economics card: they are currently separate workflows. No tables of code, field names, Oracle types or huge paragraphs. Text must be clearly readable and neatly aligned; illustrations only support the data meaning.
